purpose: Make stopping, pausing, rescheduling, withdrawal, and support routing primary fieldwork behaviors.
hard_rule: No interview goal outranks the contributor's present safety and agency.
before_interview: Tell contributor they may pause, skip, redirect, or stop without explaining.
Name that DeathVocab is not therapy, crisis care, legal advice, or clinical advice.
Confirm whether the contributor wants a support person present.
Set a time limit and aftercare plan.
Avoid early pilots with fresh grief or high-gate domains.
during_interview_stop_signs: contributor says stop, pause, I can't, or no
visible dissociation, panic, inability to continue, or repeated apology for stopping
contributor begins sharing unsafe suicide method detail or current self-harm intent
contributor seems pressured by someone else in the room
interviewer notices they are pursuing detail for curiosity rather than archive need
required_response_to_stop_signs: confirm the contributor is in control of whether to continue
offer to delete the segment if policy and consent terms permit
do not ask another content question until consent to continue is clear
document only the process fact, not additional story content
after_interview: send transcript/review plan in plain language
do not send surprise public drafts
check whether contributor wants the material held, narrowed, or withdrawn
log unresolved distress or safety concerns as blocking review debt
suicide_or_self_harm_boundary: Do not collect means or method detail.
Do not publish romanticizing or inevitability language.
If current risk is disclosed, move from archive interview to appropriate crisis/support routing according to local policy; do not continue as data collection.
